reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS order_eur
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id
),
customer_averages AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, AVG(t.order_eur) AS avg_order_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_totals t ON t.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_customers
FROM customer_averages
WHERE avg_order_eur > 500
alternatives: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS order_eur FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id), big_spenders AS (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_totals t ON t.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING AVG(t.order_eur) > 500) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM big_spenders

WITH customer_averages AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_order_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM customer_averages WHERE avg_order_eur > 500

solver.query:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS order_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id
), per_customer AS (
  SELECT customer_id, AVG(order_eur) AS avg_eur
  FROM per_order
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_customers
FROM per_customer
WHERE avg_eur > 500
